name: AP_1096_DATA_ALL
description: AP_1096_DATA_ALL contains summary payment information for 1099 type suppliers.   The Internal Revenue Service requires that you report this summary information for any qualifying payments to 1099 suppliers.  Your Oracle Payables application updates this table when you submit the 1099 Forms Report.  Your Oracle Payables application uses the summary payment information for the 1096 Report. . This table contains one record per tax entity ID.  It has no primary key.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_DOCUMENTS
columns.description: Number of documents created in last 1099 run

columns.name: TOTAL_WITHHELD
columns.description: Total MISC4 amount reported on last 1099 run

columns.name: TOTAL_REPORTED
columns.description: Total amount reported on last 1099 run

columns.name: TAX_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Identifier for tax reporting entity on last 1099 run

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: RETURN_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of return for which Form 1096 is being filed.
